name: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd.
blurb: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. researches, designs, develops, packages, tests, and sells optical communication transceiver modules and devices in China and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Optical Module Business and Others, and also engages in investment activities, project management, trading, technical services, and house rental. It is a leading player in the optical module industry, with a market capitalization of approximately 953.24 billion CNY as of May 2026.
recent: In the past 30 days, the stock has traded in a range of 835.00 to 919.99 CNY, with a 52-week range of 85.15 to 919.99 CNY. The company reported strong financials with revenue of 51.06 billion CNY (up 98.7% year-over-year) and net income of 14.95 billion CNY (up 160.2%). The stock has gained 957.46% over the past year, reflecting robust demand for optical modules driven by AI and data center growth.
